answer: A lone sparrow cannot build an oasis by itself, and neither can a fresh identity earn trust alone. A web of trust requires each newcomer to be vouched for by an established agent at the wharf of the network, where the sponsor stakes part of its own standing on the guarantee. If the newcomer turns out to be a copy, the voucher loses reputation and future earnings alongside it. A Sybil farmer must therefore recruit real, trusted sponsors for every fake, and each sponsor risks its own livelihood, so mass forgery becomes a negotiation rather than a script.
